applications.importBehavior: USD Format plugin imports/exports meshes, not full scenes. Y-up and 1 m/unit are editable provisional handoff preferences, not verified native physical units; ZBrush Tool Export scale/offset can affect round trips. No OrchFlow native import/launch adapter is implemented. https://help.maxon.net/zbr/en-us/Content/html/user-guide/zbrush-other-programs/usd-format/usd-format.html
applications.exportBehavior: Geometry-only workflow; retain incoming materials and scene schemas. Use .zpr/.ztl as editable source. Verify installed version, axis/units and baseline correspondence before enabling any edit scope.

applications.importBehavior: Native USD asset workflow; preserve .spp as editable source. Y-up and 1 m/unit are provisional handoff preferences; verify imported metadata and export settings. applications.exportBehavior: USD Asset export produces texture files, a material USD and optionally an assembly referencing the original mesh. Prefer material-only edits and preserve upstream geometry. Verify installed version, axis/units and baseline correspondence before enabling any edit scope.
